title: Ingo Swann remote viewing alien bases on the Moon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ingo Swann remote viewing alien bases on the Moon, about 1972 onward at The Moon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some of these guys like Ingo Swan would like remote view alien bases on the moon and things like that.

tall Nordic people, statuesque Nordic people who gave him a look like, "You don't belong here. Get the [ __ ] out of here and don't come back." And he saw these same people lording over basically armies of slave laborers who he said were naked
tellings.difference: Adds tall Nordic beings who warned him off, ruling over naked slave labourers on the far side, and credits Axelrod.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Ingo Swann remote viewing beings or bases on the Moon in the 1970s.

as_told.title: Ingo Swann remote views Nordics and slave labor on the Moon
